summary: First testing iteration of Palmer HVAC site. Backend (6/6 pytest) and frontend (all critical flows) PASS. POST /api/leads + GET /api/leads work, validations correct (422 for missing required / invalid email), and the full e2e form submission saves a lead and shows the success state. Header phone CTA, hero content, 15 services, 16 service areas, anchor scroll, footer credit line, no Emergent badge, and mobile menu toggle all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: created_at is stored as ISO string in Mongo and converted back to datetime when listing. Acceptable, but storing native BSON datetime is cleaner and avoids fallback to now() on parse failure.
ContactForm.jsx: client-side validation only checks presence of required fields; email format/phone format validation relies entirely on backend. Consider HTML5 pattern/regex for early UX feedback.
Backend /api/leads has no rate limiting / captcha — could be spam-abused in production (out of MVP scope but worth flagging).
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed leads (TEST_John Doe, TEST_Min User, TEST_Marker_Latest, TEST_Bad, TEST_Playwright User) in MongoDB 'leads' collection via API. No teardown executed; safe to leave in test_database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_palmer_hvac.py can be re-run via: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_palmer_hvac.py -v. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is read from /app/frontend/.env if env var not set. All data-testids match /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds.js. Shadcn Select options are opened with click + role='option' selector.
